commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin || exit 41
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-wur-forecast.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
export WORK
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch research/simulator-fidelity-kaggle-20261103 --single-branch https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
sha="$(git -C "$WORK/source" rev-parse HEAD)"
test "$sha" = 40e4a864beb6024eb93f275fdfb330d1d715067d || { echo "SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH"; exit 42; }
printf 'WUR_TRAINING_PROBE_SHA|%s\n' "$sha"
cd "$WORK/source"
python3 -m unittest -v tests.test_wur_external_benchmark tests.test_wur_forecast_probe
echo 'WUR_BOTH_TEST_MODULES|PASS'
kaggle datasets download -d piantic/autonomous-greenhouse-challengeagc-2nd-2019 -p "$WORK" >/dev/null
ARCHIVE="$(find "$WORK" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.zip' -print -quit)"
test -n "$ARCHIVE"
python3 -m tools.ml.wur_forecast_probe --zip "$ARCHIVE" --output "$WORK/probe.json"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os,json
p=Path(os.environ['WORK'])/'probe.json'
r=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert len(r['reports'])==6
assert r['original_byte_equivalence']=='NOT_VERIFIED'
assert r['training_approval']=='DIAGNOSTIC_TRANSFER_ONLY_NOT_PRODUCTION'
print('WUR_RESEARCH_PROBE|PASS')
for report in r['reports']:
 for horizon in (5,15,60):
  for target in ('temperature_c','relative_humidity_pct','co2_ppm'):
   m=report['targets'][f'{target}@{horizon}min']
   assert m['persistence']['n']==m['trained_trend']['n']
   print('WUR_UNSEEN_SITE_RESULT|'+json.dumps({
    'test_site':report['holdout_site'],'horizon_min':horizon,'target':target,
    'n':m['comparable_test_pairs'],
    'train_others_n':m['train_pair_count_five_other_sites'],
    'alpha':round(m['trained_coefficient'],5),
    'persistence_mae':round(m['persistence']['mae'],5),
    'trend_mae':round(m['trained_trend']['mae'],5),
    'gain_pct':round(m['improvement_mae_percent'],3) if m['improvement_mae_percent'] is not None else None
   },separators=(',',':')))
print('WUR_UNSEEN_HOUSEHOLD_FORECAST_COMPLETE|EXPLORATORY_NOT_CALIBRATION')
PY
